clauses: When a figure corresponding to a Deployment card performs an attack using an alternate attack pool, they may still trigger their surge abilities
unless the ability triggering the attack states otherwise
missing: Clause 2: No behavioral test of the exception path — probe never exercises an alternate-pool attack where the triggering ability explicitly blocks surge abilities via blockSurgeAbilities flag. Tusken Cycler wires _pendingBlockSurgeAbilities but no oracle test confirms surge-ability filtering at runtime.
findings.rationale: invariant_pin: regex matches code structure but lacks behavioral oracle. A future refactor could silently break surge-ability exclusion logic.

clauses: A figure must end its movement to perform an attack
not sharing a space with another non-companion figure
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: available-actions.js short-circuits attackerPos check; movement commit validates occupancy. Both behavioral paths confirmed.

clauses: During an attack, if attacker's LOS to target space changes, attacker must re-declare target
If defender moves, attacker must re-declare target
If no defender spaces are eligible, attack misses and abilities referring to target space have no effect
missing: Clause 1-2: Probe only checks source structure (no mid-attack target re-declaration path exists). No behavioral oracle simulates LOS change or defender movement during atomicity window — probes invariant existence but not runtime correction.
findings.rationale: invariant_pin: confirms pendingCombat is single object and no parallel-combat container. Does NOT test re-declaration flow if LOS/defender position changed mid-attack.

clauses: Players cannot target friendly figures with attacks
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: phase-d-target-invariants tests attack_target enumeration excludes P1 figureKeys; all returned targets verified hostile.

clauses: For a melee attack, eligible target is any hostile figure in same space or adjacent to attacker
Within 2 spaces and in LOS if attack has Reach
missing: Clause 2: Reach interaction with melee not fully tested — attack-range-defaults-probes pins Reach lifts melee to 2 but never exercises a Reach melee attack in full behavioral oracle (targeting, distance, LOS gates). Only function-level defaultAttackRange test.
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: melee range default [1,1] and distance-2 exclusion verified. Reach case (004a) only pins code math, not an end-to-end melee+Reach targeting scenario.

clauses: For a ranged attack, eligible target is any hostile figure within LOS of attacker
missing: LOS-enforcing behavior not directly tested in this atom's probe files. attack-range-defaults-probes asserts defaultAttackRange but mentions LOS-PARITY only in comment, relying on RNG-03 oracle (distance check, not LOS origin). No oracle simulates ranged attack blocked by LOS failure.
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: ranged default maxRange ≥5 verified via defaultAttackRange(). LOS requirement cited but not exercise via behavioral oracle within this atom's probes.

clauses: If attacker has abilities with timing 'before declaring an attack', performed immediately before Step 1
If target has abilities with timing 'before declaring an attack', performed immediately before Step 1
If attacker/target have timing 'before declaring a target', performed immediately before Step 1
missing: Clause 2-3: Probe only tests attacker-side timings (beforeyoudeclareattack, beforedeclaringrangedattack) via cc-timing.js routing. No test exercises TARGET-side before-declare abilities or confirms they resolve pre-Step-1.
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: cc-timing routes beforeyoudeclareattack via duringActivation and distinguishes from whenyoudeclareattack. TARGET-side and before-target timings not explicitly covered.

clauses: Abilities or mission rules which allow a figure to perform an attack may further restrict which targets are eligible
findings.rationale: certification: Multi-Fire second-attack restriction tested; handler returns early 906–908. Concrete restriction example covered.

clauses: If any abilities modify the attack dice pool, they are resolved before rolling
If any abilities modify the defense dice pool, they are resolved before rolling
missing: Clause 2: Defense-pool modifications not tested. Probe pins attack-pool mutation block (baseDice, bonus, remove, keep, fill) but explicitly notes 'we do not test defense pool mutations here' comment in handler. Defense-pool timing uncovered.
findings.rationale: invariant_pin: attack-pool source-order confirmed (mutations before rollAttackDice). Defense pool entirely absent from probes — no behavioral oracle for defense modifiers.

clauses: If players have any effects that reroll dice, they are resolved now
When dice are rerolled, their old results are ignored and new results are used instead
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: combat-handler-oracles tests die reroll replaces old fixture exactly; totals recomputed correctly. Unchanged dice preserved.

clauses: Each die may be rerolled only once per attack regardless of who is rerolling the die
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: 005c G12 second reroll rejected; B-C-REROLL-004 forced reroll respects single-reroll limit.

clauses: At the end of Step 4, each evade result cancels one surge result
At the end of this step each ability providing modifiers is not resolved until Step 5
findings.rationale: invariant_pin: evadeCancelled = Math.min(rawSurge, totalEvade); totalSurge = rawSurge - evadeCancelled. Surge-spending (Step 5) source-ordered after cancellation (021d). computeCombatResult reads pre-computed evadeCancelledSurge, no recompute.

clauses: Conditions are mission rules, so they perform their modifications to the results first
Hidden affects the attack results
Weakened affects the attack/defense results
missing: Clause 1: CRR says 'conditions perform their modifications first' but probe only tests Hidden/Weakened specifics, not the ordering guarantee vs other Step-4 modifier types (accuracy modifiers, symbol adds/removes).
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: Hidden -4 accuracy penalty on ranged; Weakened -1 block on defender. Condition-first ordering not verified vs other Step-4 modifiers.

clauses: If there are any surge results remaining, attacker may spend them to trigger surge abilities
Each surge ability can be used only once per attack
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: B-C-SURGE-003 Overload blocks 3rd surge index; B-C-SURGE-004 non-Overload unit blocked after 1 use. Per-surge limit verified.

clauses: If performing a ranged attack, total Accuracy value must be equal to or greater than number of spaces target is away
If total Accuracy < distance, the attack misses
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: 004b acc 2 vs dist 4 misses; 004g acc exactly equal dist hits; 004c melee bypasses accuracy gate.

clauses: Line of sight and distance between attacker and target are determined separately
For large figures they might use different spaces for their determination
findings.rationale: invariant_pin: distance loop (min-reduction) and LOS loop (first-hit search) are structurally independent. Range gate applied between (025c). Target-footprint enumeration for multi-cell targets (025e).

clauses: If attack misses due to insufficient accuracy or dodge, target suffers no damage
Otherwise, Pierce allows attack to ignore a number of block results
Remaining block results subtracted from total damage results
Target suffers all remaining damage
missing: Clause 1: Dodge miss case not covered in combat-oracles basic-damage tests (all test hit condition). Oracle 004a tests dodge miss but within combat-oracles; the damage-formula oracle does not isolate dodge-miss from accuracy-miss.
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: 001a/c/005 pin damage formula and pierce. Dodge-miss covered in combat-oracles but not strictly in damage-calc oracle.

clauses: After attack resolves, Blast abilities are resolved
Cleave abilities are resolved
Condition keywords are resolved
missing: Clause 1-3: Probe tests Blast and Cleave triggering when target is killed/survives but does NOT test Condition keyword resolution (Stun, Bleed) in 'after attack resolves' phase. No oracle confirms Conditions fire after damage is calculated and before 'after action resolves'.
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: blast-cleave-oracles pins Blast/Cleave behavior. Condition-keyword timing in 'after resolves' phase not explicitly tested.

clauses: Effects that trigger after attack resolves use 'during an attack' timing conflict resolution order
After performing attack and after resolving attack refer to the same timing instance
During an Attack action, all 'after resolving an attack' abilities must resolve before any 'after resolving an action' abilities
missing: Clause 2: Probe only tests post-rolls resolver is sole site. No behavioral oracle confirms 'after performing' = 'after resolving' equivalence or tests timing ordering vs 'after action resolves'.
findings.rationale: invariant_pin: resolveCombatAfterRolls is sole post-rolls site. Slow-on-the-Draw nulls pendingCombat. Post-attack vs post-action ordering not tested behaviorally.

clauses: A figure with a Deployment card can use only one of its actions to attack per activation
This includes special actions like Pounce or Brutality
missing: Clause 2: Unit test only checks 'already attacked this activation → 0' but does not verify that special actions EMPLOYING attacks (Pounce multi-strike, Brutality cascade) count against the single-attack-per-activation limit. No behavioral test of Pounce or Brutality interaction.
findings.rationale: unit_test: move-features.test.js tests flag only. Special-action attacks (Pounce, Brutality) uncovered — silent regression would allow repeated special-action attacks in one activation.

clauses: If an ability allows a figure to perform an attack outside of its activation, this attack does not count toward the limit of one attack per activation
missing: Happy path (flag set → attack offered) tested (001a); negative (flag absent + no Assault → attack blocked, 001b) tested. But no oracle tests that the attack AFTER it fires does NOT increment attackPerformedThisActivation for the figure's own later-activation attack budget.
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: probe surfaces free-attack flag bypass but does not verify that the free attack later doesn't consume the figure's one-per-activation budget when the figure activates normally.

clauses: A figure cannot target an empty space with an attack
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: every surfaced attack_target verified to carry a targetFigureKey mapping to current figure; empty-space test fails.

clauses: A figure cannot target a friendly figure with an attack
Note that friendly figures may suffer damage from some abilities such as Blast
missing: Clause 1: Only one assertion (002c adjacent FRIENDLY takes splash from Blast). Clause 1 attack-targeting restriction not re-tested in this atom — overlaps with CRR-ATK-009. Clause 2 ('friendly may suffer Blast') is primary test focus, but direct attack-target filtering not confirmed here.
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: Blast splash on friendly tested; attack-targeting restriction covered by CRR-ATK-009. Minimal duplication.

clauses: Blast, Cleave, and Condition keywords require target to suffer one or more damage to be performed after attack resolves
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: 001a zero-damage blocks Stun; 001b zero-damage blocks Bleed; 002a positive-damage applies Stun; 002b positive-damage applies Bleed. Damage-gate verified.

clauses: Some abilities allow players to perform an attack with a hostile figure
The player resolving the ability controls the hostile figure for the duration of that attack
The player resolving the ability chooses the target of the attack
All non-neutral figures are considered hostile; no figures are considered friendly
The figure cannot target itself
findings.rationale: invariant_pin: pendingFalseOrders records controlledFigureKey, controlledPlayerNum, controllerPlayerNum separately. Controlled pool drawn from enemyNum. Target enumeration excludes controlledFigureKey. Four+ downstream combat sites use falseOrdersControllerPlayerNum ?? attackerPlayerNum pattern.

clauses: The player resolving the ability rolls the attack dice
The player can use any of the figure's abilities as if the figure were their own
A figure that uses such an ability does not count as having performed an attack
The resolver may spend one of that figure's power tokens
findings.rationale: invariant_pin: attackInfo from controlledStats.attack. Controlled passives applied. attackerFigureKey=controlledFigureKey (tokens). attackerMsgId=falseOrdersMsgId (not controlled-figure's own activation). Power-token and surge-spend gated on controller.

clauses: An ability that does not involve an attack but causes a figure to suffer damage is not considered to be an attack
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: Force Choke applies 2 damage + 1 strain to chosen target without attack mechanics. HP calculation correct (5 - 3 = 2).

clauses: Ranged attacks need enough Accuracy to not miss the target
Amount of Accuracy needed is equal to number of spaces attacker is away from target
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: accuracy-penalty-oracles 004 and combat-oracles 004b/g test accuracy miss at distance < acc and hit at acc ≥ distance.

clauses: Attacker's total Accuracy is determined by adding all accuracy results from dice and applying any Accuracy modifiers provided by abilities and conditions
missing: Probe tests Take Cover sets roundDefenseAccuracyPenalty (not roundDefenseBonusEvade) and cumulative CC penalties but does NOT test accuracy GAIN from abilities — only penalty cases. No oracle for ability-granted accuracy bonus (e.g., surge accuracy).
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: 001 Take Cover penalty routing; 003 cumulative CC penalties. Accuracy-bonus abilities (surge accuracy spending) uncovered.

clauses: While attacking an adjacent figure with a ranged attack, attacker needs at least 1 Accuracy
This also applies to attacking a Companion in the same space
missing: Clause 2: Companion-in-same-space case NOT tested. Probe tests adjacent (distance-1) ranged miss at acc=0 but does not isolate Companion special case or test distance-0 same-space with Companion.
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: 003a distance-1 acc=0 ranged miss verified. Companion (distance-0 adjacent by definition) case uncovered.

clauses: Attacking an object in the same space requires 0 accuracy
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: PROBE-PD-ACC-004 ranged attack vs distance-0 same-space passes acc gate with acc=0.

clauses: Some effects can cause an attack to miss
When an attack misses, the target suffers zero damage
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: 004a dodge → miss, damage = 0; 004b accuracy miss (acc 2 vs dist 4).

clauses: The dodge icon found on the white die causes the attack to miss
missing: Probe tests dodge → miss but does NOT test the exception: surge-ability cancellation of dodge (004e surgeCancelDodge, Deadly Spin). Only positive dodge-miss path tested; dodge-cancellation mechanism not verified.
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: 004a dodge → miss; 004e notes surgeCancelDodge cancels dodge but doesn't verify Deadly Spin executes or dodge cancellation flow.

clauses: While performing a ranged attack, the attack requires Accuracy greater than or equal to the distance to the target
If total Accuracy < distance, then the attack misses
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: combat-oracles 004b miss at acc 2 < dist 4; 004g hit at acc = dist; accuracy-penalty-oracles 004 cumulative penalty misses.

clauses: When an attack misses, other effects can still be triggered such as using the Recover keyword
findings.rationale: invariant_pin: Recover heal branch has no hit/damage guard (004a). Rule intent documented (004b). Recover outside post-hit/damage chain (004c). Cleave IS damage-gated — demonstrates pattern Recover lacks (004d). Recover accumulates during surge with no predicate (004e). Embed-refresh fires on 0-damage heal (004f).

clauses: Ability requiring target figure to suffer one or more damage (Blast, Cleave, Condition keyword) — miss prevents that ability from being resolved because target suffers no damage
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: G22 violation Bleed applied despite 0 damage flagged; G22 positive path Bleed with damage > 0.

clauses: This keyword allows a figure to ignore a number of block results while attacking
Example: Pierce 2 allows attack to ignore up to 2 results
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: 005a pierce 2 vs 3 block → 2 damage net (1 block remains).

clauses: Pierce value is applied after any Accuracy modifiers are applied
missing: Probe file phase-d-pierce-ordering-probe.test.js does not exist in test tree. Cannot verify source-order pin or behavioral test of pierce timing vs accuracy modifiers.
findings.rationale: No evidence files in manifest. Probe missing entirely — coverage status unknown.

clauses: If multiple Pierce abilities are used during an attack, their values are added together
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: PROBE-PD-PRC-003 surgePierce=1 + bonusPierce=2 → total 3 pierce reduces 3 block.

clauses: A figure must spend one additional movement point to enter a space containing difficult terrain
A figure doesn't need to spend additional movement points to exit a space containing difficult terrain
Line of sight can be traced through difficult terrain
If a space contains a hostile figure and difficult terrain, other figures must spend two additional movement points to enter the space
When a large figure enters difficult terrain, it spends only one additional movement point, regardless of the number of spaces of difficult terrain that it occupies
Figures that have Massive or Mobile ignore extra movement points costs
missing: Clause 4: Difficult + hostile stacking tested (PROBE-TERRAIN-004). Clauses 1, 2, 3, 5, 6: Difficult terrain alone (PROBE-TERRAIN-002) entry tested but NOT exit (CRR-DT-002 handles exit separately). Large-figure clause NOT tested — probe assumes 1x1 profiles. Mobile/Massive ignore tested but NOT isolated to entry gate for large.
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: terrain-stacking-probes uses BASE_PROFILE (1x1, not large). Large-figure single +1 surcharge claim uncovered — no test of multi-cell difficult terrain entry.

clauses: A figure doesn't need to spend additional movement points to exit a space containing difficult terrain
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: 002a moving from difficult-origin cell to normal costs exactly 1 MP (base cost). 002c source pin notes movement.js has no exitingDifficult branch — asymmetry is literal.

clauses: Line of sight can be traced through difficult terrain
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: PROBE-PD-DT-003 LOS a1→e1 with difficult at c1 passes.

clauses: If a space contains a hostile figure and difficult terrain, other figures must spend two additional movement points to enter the space (one for the figure and one for the terrain)
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: PROBE-TERRAIN-004 difficult + hostile stack costs 3 MP (base 1 + difficult 1 + hostile 1). Additive formula verified.

clauses: When a large figure enters difficult terrain, it spends only one additional movement point, regardless of the number of spaces of difficult terrain that it occupies
Figures that have Massive or Mobile ignore extra movement points costs
missing: Clause 1: Large-figure difficult terrain single +1 surcharge claim NOT tested. Probe fixture uses 1x1 BASE_PROFILE. Clause 2 tested only for terrain-only cells, not stacked difficult + hostile with large figure.
findings.rationale: invariant_pin: 005a entering = nextFootprint minus prevFootprint. 005b enteringDifficult is single boolean (Array.some). 005c DT surcharge +1 unconditional. But large-figure multi-cell scenario uncovered.

clauses: Figures that have Massive or Mobile ignore extra movement points costs (including difficult and hostile)
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: 005b Massive ignores difficult terrain; ignoreDifficult on difficult-only cell → 1 MP. movement-legality-behavioral and terrain-stacking-probes both verify.

clauses: Each surge ability can be triggered only once per attack
findings.rationale: direct_oracle: 001 Bossk [damage 2, pierce 2]; 004a spending both surges → correct final damage.
